_role: Value pins of the chat-coherent drift tier: run-to-run drift detection on a real model, successor to the retired tests/end_to_end goldens. Unlike tests/golden/paper_goldens.json (paper-provenance values), these ARE pinned from a reviewed run of this stack on the canonical GPU - that is their job.

tolerance._comment: discrete match metrics tolerate one flipped row of 64; continuous keys use the default. Tighten after the first captures establish observed drift.
